wave: Wave B — Certification Manifest Evidence Bundle Reference
objective: Connect a Certification Manifest to an actual MCC-EB-001 Evidence Bundle through the exact normative Evidence Bundle Reference model defined by MCC-CM-001 Section 14, reusing the Wave A Evidence Bundle producer/verifier and structured Hash Reference rather than creating a second Evidence Bundle model, a second HashReference type, a parallel Certification Manifest subsystem, or a duplicate verifier.
source_baseline_commit_note: Requirement IDs, statuses, and source_line values below were re-verified against the current 810-requirement baseline (post-PR #63) at conformance/normative-v1.0/requirements.json before any production code was written.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: A Certification Manifest references exactly one primary Evidence Bundle corresponding to the certification run the Manifest describes.
selected_requirements.source_section: 14.2 Primary Evidence Bundle Reference / 14.5 Evidence Bundle Reference Invariants
selected_requirements.rationale_before: No Evidence Bundle Reference object existed in this repository; there was nothing to reference an Evidence Bundle with.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No mechanism existed to bind a Manifest-level container to exactly one Evidence Bundle.
selected_requirements.production_change: src/mcc_evidence/cm001_manifest.py:CM001Manifest.primary_evidence_bundle_reference is a single required field (not a list); build_cm001_manifest and CM001Manifest.from_dict both fail closed without one.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: The primary Evidence Bundle Reference includes the Evidence Bundle identifier, Schema Version, and a Hash Reference binding the Manifest to that Bundle's Integrity Record.
selected_requirements.source_section: 14.2 Primary Evidence Bundle Reference / 14.5 Evidence Bundle Reference Invariants
selected_requirements.rationale_before: No Evidence Bundle Reference object existed to carry these fields.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No code read an Evidence Bundle's own identifier/schema version and bound a Hash Reference to its Integrity Record.
selected_requirements.production_change: build_evidence_bundle_reference reads bundle_descriptor.json for bundle_id/schema_version and computes a Hash Reference over integrity_record.json's raw bytes, with content_ref set to the Bundle identifier (the exact example CM-HASH-001 gives).

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: A supplementary Evidence Bundle Reference is distinguishable from the primary reference.
selected_requirements.source_section: 14.3 Supplementary Evidence Bundle References / 14.5 Evidence Bundle Reference Invariants
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No storage distinction or ambiguity check existed between a primary and supplementary reference.
selected_requirements.production_change: CM001Manifest stores primary_evidence_bundle_reference and supplementary_evidence_bundle_references in separate fields with an explicit kind (PRIMARY/SUPPLEMENTARY) tag; build_cm001_manifest's _validate_distinguishable rejects, before any write, a supplementary reference sharing the primary's bundle_id, and rejects duplicate supplementary references.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: An unverifiable primary Evidence Bundle Reference invalidates the Manifest.
selected_requirements.source_section: 14.4 Reference Integrity / 14.5 Evidence Bundle Reference Invariants
selected_requirements.rationale_before: No Manifest-level verification existed to invalidate on an unverifiable reference.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No fail-closed cross-artifact verification existed binding a Manifest to a specific Bundle's actual content.
selected_requirements.production_change: verify_cm001_manifest returns INVALID for the whole Manifest the moment the primary Evidence Bundle Reference fails verify_evidence_bundle_reference (wrong bundle_id, wrong schema_version, or a Hash Reference that does not recompute against the actual Integrity Record), independent of any supplementary references.

selected_requirements.normative_obligation: Every Evidence Bundle Reference includes at least one Hash Reference.
selected_requirements.source_section: 13.4 Hash Reference Usage / 13.5 Hash Reference Invariants
selected_requirements.rationale_before: Excluded from Wave A: its subject (the Evidence Bundle Reference) did not exist yet; certifications/manifest.json's evidence_digest was the closest but differently-scoped analog.
selected_requirements.missing_behavior_before: No Evidence Bundle Reference existed to check for Hash Reference presence.
selected_requirements.production_change: EvidenceBundleReference.hash_references is a non-empty tuple by construction (build_evidence_bundle_reference always computes at least one); EvidenceBundleReference.from_dict fails closed on a zero-length hash_references array.
dependencies: CM-EBREF-002 (the Evidence Bundle Reference object this requirement's subject is)

excluded_candidate_rationale: All 5 originally-listed candidates (CM-EBREF-001..004, CM-HASH-003) were verified against the current 810-requirement baseline and full normative text; all 5 exist with materially matching normative meaning and were fully implementable within this bounded wave. None was excluded.
additional_dependency_rationale: None. No requirement ID outside the 5 originally-listed candidates was added as a dependency. Wave A's EB-FILE-001/002 (Bundle Descriptor/Integrity Record presence) and CM-HASH-001/002/004 (Hash Reference model) are reused as already-CONFORMANT dependencies, not newly claimed by this PR.
not_implemented_in_this_pr: The complete MCC-CM-001 Certification Manifest (Certification Metadata, Requirement Results, Manifest Schema beyond the Evidence Bundle Reference fields) -- deferred fields, see implementation report
